activity_phrase: offers 100 kWh Powerpack for peak shaving, load shifting and demand response
source_sentence: In addition, we offer a 100 kWh Powerpack for peak shaving, load shifting and demand response for commercial customers and for renewable firming and a variety of grid services for utilities.

activity_phrase: pioneers advanced manufacturing techniques for battery packs

activity_phrase: works with lithium-ion cell suppliers to optimize cell designs
source_sentence: We have significant expertise in the safety and management systems needed to use lithium-ion cells in the automotive environment, and have actively worked with lithium-ion cell suppliers to further optimize cell designs to increase overall performance.

activity_phrase: upgrades battery of Model S
source_sentence: For example, in 2015 alone, we upgraded the battery of our lowest range Model S from 60 kWh to 70 kWh, and our highest range Model S to 90 kWh.

activity_phrase: designs battery pack to permit flexibility with respect to battery cell chemistry and form factor
source_sentence: For instance, we have designed our battery pack to permit flexibility with respect to battery cell chemistry and form factor.

activity_phrase: maintains testing and R&D capabilities at the individual cell level, the full battery-pack level, and other critical battery pack systems
source_sentence: We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities at the individual cell level, the full battery-pack level, and other critical battery pack systems.

activity_phrase: evaluates new battery cells as they become commercially viable
source_sentence: We believe that the flexibility of our designs, combined with our research and real-world performance data, will enable us to continue to evaluate new battery cells as they become commercially viable, and thereby optimize battery pack system performance and cost for our current and future vehicles.

activity_phrase: optimizes battery pack system performance and cost for current and future vehicles

activity_phrase: develops a family of drive inverter designs customized to proprietary motor designs
source_sentence: Tesla has developed a family of drive inverter designs that are customized to its proprietary motor designs to most efficiently meet the demands of each of our vehicles.

activity_phrase: designs chargers that convert alternating current into direct current for battery charging
source_sentence: The second function, charging the battery pack, is accomplished by the charger, which converts alternating current (usually from a wall outlet or other electricity source) into direct current that can be accepted by the battery.

activity_phrase: offers a Mobile Connector for multiple charging services
source_sentence: In most markets, Tesla vehicles come with a Mobile Connector that allows for multiple different charging services to be used.

activity_phrase: offers a Tesla Wall Connector for higher power charging
source_sentence: In many markets, Tesla offers a Tesla Wall Connector that can be set up to provide higher power charging than the Mobile Connectors.

activity_phrase: operates a Supercharger network for fast charging

activity_phrase: writes custom firmware for vehicle processors

activity_phrase: develops software for vehicle control and infotainment
source_sentence: We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally.

activity_phrase: equips vehicles with hardware for incremental introduction of autopilot technology
source_sentence: In October of 2014, we began equipping all Model S vehicles with hardware to allow for the incremental introduction of autopilot technology.

activity_phrase: designs and engineers bodies, chassis, interiors, heating and cooling and low voltage electrical systems in house
source_sentence: We design and engineer bodies, chassis, interiors, heating and cooling and low voltage electrical systems in house and to a lesser extent in conjunction with our suppliers.

activity_phrase: operates Service Plus locations combining retail sales and service
source_sentence: We refer to these as “Service Plus” locations.

activity_phrase: collects initial payment upon order and remaining payment upon delivery
source_sentence: To begin production or make a reservation, we require an initial payment which is collected once the customer has selected the vehicle specifications and has entered into a purchase agreement.

activity_phrase: diagnoses and remedies vehicle problems remotely via wireless data upload
source_sentence: Our vehicles are designed with the capability to wirelessly upload the data to us via an on-board system with cellular connectivity, allowing us to diagnose and remedy many problems before ever looking at the vehicle.

activity_phrase: offers an eight year, infinite mile warranty for the battery and drive unit on current new vehicles
source_sentence: For the battery and drive unit on our current new vehicles, we offer an eight year, infinite mile warranty, although the battery’s charging capacity is not covered.

activity_phrase: offers a comprehensive maintenance program for every new vehicle
source_sentence: In addition to the New Vehicle Limited Warranty, we offer a comprehensive maintenance program for every new vehicle, which includes plans covering prepaid maintenance for up to eight years or up to 100,000 miles and an Extended Service plan.

activity_phrase: offers an Extended Service plan

activity_phrase: offers financing arrangements directly through local subsidiaries in certain areas of the United States, Germany, Canada and the UK
source_sentence: We also offer financing arrangements directly through our local subsidiaries in certain areas of the United States, Germany, Canada and the UK.

activity_phrase: provides customers with a resale value guarantee
source_sentence: Certain of our financing programs provide customers with a resale value guarantee under which those customers have the option of selling their vehicle back to us at a preset future date, generally during the period of 36 to 39 months following delivery for a pre-determined resale value .

activity_phrase: offers residual value guarantees to financial institutions
source_sentence: In certain markets, we also offer residual value guarantees to financial institutions which may obligate us to repurchase the vehicles for a pre-determined price.

source_sentence: We are also building a cell and battery manufacturing facility, the Tesla Gigafactory, outside of Reno, Nevada.

source_sentence: In addition, we manufacture lithium-ion battery packs, electric motors, gearboxes and components for our vehicles at the Tesla Factory.

source_sentence: We machine various aluminum components at our facility in Lathrop, California and are nearing completion of a site expansion to include an aluminum castings operation.

activity_phrase: plans to produce Model S, Model X and Model 3 at the Tesla Factory
source_sentence: We plan to produce Model S, Model X and Model 3 at the Tesla Factory.

activity_phrase: assembles Tesla Energy products in the first portion of the Gigafactory

activity_phrase: expects to produce cells at the Gigafactory beginning in 2016
source_sentence: We currently expect to produce cells at the Gigafactory beginning in 2016 for use initially in our Tesla Energy products and later for our vehicles.

activity_phrase: manufactures solely zero emission vehicles

activity_phrase: sells earned CAFE credits

activity_phrase: completes transportation tests for battery packs

activity_phrase: uses lithium metal oxide cells in high voltage battery packs

activity_phrase: has an agreement with a third party battery recycling company to recycle battery packs

activity_phrase: accepts depleted battery packs from customers
